name: @chirp/protocol
description: Framework-agnostic TypeScript chat protocol core for chirp: connection state machine, the five hook interfaces + ChatPipeline, and the sensitive-word pre-check interceptor. No React/DOM dependencies — the game-facing TS integration surface (minigame/LayaAir/Cocos). Companion apps do NOT depend on this package: their protocol layer lives in apps/shared/protocol (@chirp/app-protocol), same boundary rule as apps/android .../protocol/ and apps/ios Sources/ChirpProtocol/.
